description:
From: GC. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 (verbatim "ignore it then; proceed.", answering the fz-9x7.47 obsolescence audit).

Evidence: Heap::contains_heap_addr (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:581 at #880's 4b56bb8e8) has no production caller. Callers: aot_shim_test, gift_test, heap_test, mailbox_test, sched_test (runtime crate) and src/ir_interp/backend_test.rs:315 (fz crate), so it cannot simply be cfg(test). It answers 'does this heap own the address', which the age table cannot.

Change: move it, and the debug range helpers it uses where test-only, behind a test-support feature the fz crate's tests enable (or move the fz-crate test's check onto a runtime-side test), so release builds carry no test-only heap API.

Done when: no test-only heap API compiles into a release runtime; the tests keep their assertions.
title: contains_heap_addr is test support
